text:
Kevin: Heads up — seeing a recurring spike on shelf-18 that correlates with dedicated-slices allocation. latency up ~40ms p50 for gen requests when new tenants get pinned to that shelf. anyone else seeing this?
Maria: Yep saw the alert earlier. p99 tails also moved. Think it's nvlink contention + egressthrottle.
Sophie: Could be a routing issue too — our fastpath prefers local rack for latency SLO, so new dedicated slices get packed and saturate the top-of-rack.
Anil: Logs show a lot of requeue events around the same time. snippet: `2024-06-14T10:12:03Z alloc:dedicated-slice create id=ds-987 requeue=3 reason=egress_backpressure`
Ryan: ops-bot triggered a thermal event on that shelf ~10:10, but temps looked normal after 2m. ops-bot: Alert shelf-18 thermal probe: short spike 79C -> throttled fans -> cleared.
Kevin: If thermal was transient it could have moved workloads and then the scheduler backfilled poorly. We should avoid aggressive backfill into racks that recently had thermal events.
Maria: Agreed. Suggestion: add a short hazard window (5m) where we bias routing away from recently-throttled shelves. Lower risk than full quarantine.
Sophie: Also curious about noise fingerprinting — tenant A does tiny-batch beam search that pins HBM and NVMe IO, while tenant B uses long-context generation with large KV cache. Co-locating them is bad.
Anil: We could extend dedicated pool policies to include an isolation tag `no-cohost-kv-io`. Quick patch idea: router config add `avoid_tags: ["kv-heavy","io-heavy"]` for shelf-affinity.
Ryan: Cost tradeoff: that reduces packing efficiency, increases reserved pools. Need estimate of extra idle capacity needed.
Kevin: Runbook item: for now, set a soft-avoid for shelf-18 and divert new dedicated-slice placements for next 30m. I'll open a quick repro and post metrics.
Maria: I'll add a grafana panel to compare p50/p99 and requeue counts pre/post.
Sophie: If we make the hazard window configurable per-region we can tune APAC vs EU differently — APAC racks are already tighter.
Anil: I'll prototype router change. patch will be tiny: `routes: - match: dedicated create: avoid_recent_throttle: 300s`
Ryan: Ping me when prototype is on staging. We'll run a 2h canary and watch cost delta.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: branch=router/no-cohost-tag, env=staging, id=deploy_4592
Kevin: Thanks. If anyone sees a million requeues or a mass preempt, abort the deploy and fallback to old router. :warning:
Maria: Noted. posting current panels now -> https://grafana.redwood/s/dash/shelf-18
Sophie: TL;DR — temporary soft-avoid, prototype router tag-avoid, canary on staging, cost vs packing analysis after 2h.
ops-bot: Note: created incident-INC-2024-142 for tracking the shelf-18 noisy neighbor cascade.
